sources.scope: Grouped drawing lists CAB.618.E as 150 mm. The illustrated 200 mm sibling is labelled ±6 mm; that is not an explicit tolerance guarantee for the 150 mm SKU.

Published Taoglas 1.13 mm family cable: OD ±0.05 mm; minimum bend radius 6.8 mm; attenuation 3.1 dB/m at 2.4 GHz. The exact internal wire part number of CAB.618.E is not established by the public assembly catalogue; this is an engineering basis, not lot-specific qualification.

project_allowances.shortfall_basis: Conservative engineering allowance from grouped drawing, not a dedicated CAB.618.E tolerance specification. Measure delivered usable length before routing.
project_allowances.thread_stack_scope: Arithmetic residual only, not a guarantee of full antenna engagement. Check actual nut, washer, shoulder and antenna on the 3 mm coupon; hold the shoulder when tightening.
project_allowances.unbent_connector_basis: 17 mm reference heatshrink plus up to 4 mm flange/body length from (14.8+0.3)-(11.4-0.3). A 27 mm guide lead-in retains at least 21 mm straight after the first 6.8 mm fillet.

step_model.reason: Published link returned a Cloudflare challenge; no dimensions inferred from inaccessible model.

acceptance: Use standard SMA female centre socket, not RP-SMA, and I-PEX MHF I/U.FL, not MHF4.
Fit supplied washer and nut; prevent barrel rotation using its shoulder flats while tightening the antenna.
Print coupon first. All three 6.6/6.8/7.0 mm trials are 3 mm thick, matching the base wall.
Reject a delivered cable that cannot follow its smooth route with 25 mm service slack. Never bend the heatshrink or tension a U.FL socket.
